headline: So I built it a chess harness 🧵

media.alt: Video from the post by Dhruv

text:
1/ Jev has a chess rating now. 1023 Elo.

Jev is TypeSafe's "System One" decision model. No search, no planning. You hand it a situation and options, it picks one with a confidence score. Built for routing and classification. Not games.

So I built it a chess harness 🧵
